$description: Stage 7. Duration scales with how far a thing travels. A sheet crossing the viewport is slow; a hover is nearly instant. Every one of these has a reduced-motion pair the token build writes.

easing.$description: sheet is the curve iOS uses for a presented surface: fast off the mark, long settle, no overshoot, because overshoot on a full-height plane reads as a bounce rather than as physics. spring is a sampled real spring, for small things that can afford to overshoot.
